stt._noise_guard_note: Lower min_lang_prob / raise max_no_speech_prob if real speech is being discarded. Raise min_lang_prob / lower max_no_speech_prob if background noise leaks through.
stt._allowed_languages_note: Whisper hallucinations (Korean, Turkish etc from fan noise) are discarded if detected language is not in this list. Set to null to accept all languages.
stt.initial_prompt: Speak in English or Hindi only.
stt._initial_prompt_note: Biases Whisper decoder towards English/Hindi tokens from the first frame, preventing Korean/Turkish hallucinations.

_model_options_note.qwen2.5:0.5b: FASTEST — 397MB, runs great on i3. Use this for speed.
_model_options_note.phi3:mini: 2.2GB — better quality than 0.5b, still fast on CPU.
_model_options_note.qwen2.5:3b: Smarter but slower — 1.9GB, use if you need better reasoning.
